label: 比
note: Compares two things: A is more … than B.
A 比 B + adjective (no 很): 我比他高。

sentences.en: My older brother is taller than me.
sentences.pron: Gēge bǐ wǒ gāo.

sentences.en: Today is colder than yesterday.
sentences.pron: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.

sentences.en: Running is more tiring than swimming.
sentences.pron: Pǎobù bǐ yóuyǒng lèi.

sentences.en: This one is cheaper than that one.
sentences.pron: Zhège bǐ nàge piányi.

sentences.en: My phone is newer than yours.
sentences.pron: Wǒ de shǒujī bǐ nǐ de xīn.

sentences.en: Coffee costs more than tea.
sentences.pron: Kāfēi bǐ chá guì.

sentences.en: She is two years older than me.
sentences.pron: Tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.

label: 正在…呢
note: An action going on right now.
正在 + verb (+ 呢): 他正在睡觉呢。

sentences.en: I'm reading right now.
sentences.pron: Wǒ zhèngzài kàn shū ne.

sentences.en: Mom is cooking right now.
sentences.pron: Māma zhèngzài zuò cài ne.

sentences.en: They're playing basketball right now.
sentences.pron: Tāmen zhèngzài dǎlánqiú ne.

sentences.en: The child is sleeping right now.
sentences.pron: Háizi zhèngzài shuìjiào ne.

sentences.en: It's raining in Beijing right now.
sentences.pron: Běijīng zhèngzài xiàyǔ ne.

sentences.en: What are you doing right now?
sentences.pron: Nǐ zhèngzài zuò shénme ne?

sentences.en: Dad is reading the paper right now.
sentences.pron: Bàba zhèngzài kàn bàozhǐ ne.

label: 一下
note: Softens a verb: do it briefly or casually.
verb + 一下: 你看一下。

sentences.en: Please have a listen.
sentences.pron: Qǐng nǐ tīng yīxià.

sentences.en: Let me take a look at your book.
sentences.pron: Wǒ kàn yīxià nǐ de shū.

sentences.en: Let's rest for a bit.
sentences.pron: Wǒmen xiūxi yīxià ba.

sentences.en: Could you come here a moment?
sentences.pron: Nǐ lái yīxià, hǎo ma?

sentences.en: I'll just ask the teacher.
sentences.pron: Wǒ wèn yīxià lǎoshī.

sentences.en: Introduce your friend.
sentences.pron: Nǐ jièshào yīxià nǐ de péngyou.

sentences.en: Let me think for a second.
sentences.pron: Ràng wǒ xiǎng yīxià.

label: 因为…所以
note: Gives a reason, then the result.
因为 A，所以 B

sentences.en: Because it rained, I didn't go.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù.

sentences.t: 因为他生病了，所以没来。
sentences.en: He was sick, so he didn't come.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi tā shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ méi lái.

sentences.t: 因为太累了，所以我想休息。
sentences.en: I'm too tired, so I want to rest.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi tài lèi le, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng xiūxi.

sentences.t: 因为很便宜，所以我买了。
sentences.en: It was cheap, so I bought it.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi hěn piányi, suǒyǐ wǒ mǎi le.

sentences.t: 因为天气好，所以我们去玩。
sentences.en: The weather is nice, so we're going out.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi tiānqì hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒmen qù wán.

sentences.t: 因为有考试，所以他很忙。
sentences.en: He has an exam, so he's busy.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi yǒu kǎoshì, suǒyǐ tā hěn máng.

sentences.t: 因为我不懂，所以我问了老师。
sentences.en: I didn't understand, so I asked the teacher.
sentences.pron: Yīnwèi wǒ bù dǒng, suǒyǐ wǒ wèn le lǎoshī.

label: 是…的
note: Stresses when, where or how a past action happened.
是 + detail + verb + 的: 我是昨天来的。

sentences.en: I came by plane.
sentences.pron: Wǒ shì zuò fēijī lái de.

sentences.en: How did you get here?
sentences.pron: Nǐ shì zěnme lái de?

sentences.en: He came yesterday.
sentences.pron: Tā shì zuótiān lái de.

sentences.en: We met in Beijing.
sentences.pron: Wǒmen shì zài Běijīng rènshi de.

sentences.en: Where did you buy this book?
sentences.pron: Zhè běn shū shì zài nǎr mǎi de?

sentences.en: She came to China last year.
sentences.pron: Tā shì qùnián lái Zhōngguó de.

sentences.en: I went with a friend.
sentences.pron: Wǒ shì hé péngyou yīqǐ qù de.

label: 了 vs 过
note: 了: an action got done. 过: you have done it before.
去了 went · 去过 have been

sentences.en: I haven't been to Beijing yet.
sentences.pron: Wǒ hái méi qù guò Běijīng.

sentences.en: I've never seen this movie.
sentences.pron: Wǒ méi kàn guò zhège diànyǐng.

sentences.en: Have you ever had Chinese food?
sentences.pron: Nǐ chī guò Zhōngguó cài ma?

sentences.en: He has been to my home before.
sentences.pron: Tā lái guò wǒ jiā.

sentences.en: He has already left.
sentences.pron: Tā yǐjīng zǒu le.

sentences.en: It's started raining.
sentences.pron: Xiàyǔ le.

sentences.en: I'll call you when I get there.
sentences.pron: Wǒ dào le jiù gěi nǐ dǎdiànhuà.

sentences.en: I bought two books today.
sentences.pron: Wǒ jīntiān mǎi le liǎng běn shū.

label: 虽然…但是
note: Admits one fact, then says the other still holds.
虽然 A，但是 B

sentences.t: 虽然很累，但是我很高兴。
sentences.en: Although I'm tired, I'm happy.
sentences.pron: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ hěn gāoxìng.

sentences.t: 虽然下雨了，但是他还是来了。
sentences.en: It rained, but he still came.
sentences.pron: Suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshì tā háishi lái le.

sentences.en: It's expensive, but it's delicious.
sentences.pron: Suīrán hěn guì, dànshì hěn hǎochī.

sentences.t: 虽然他很忙，但是经常来看我。
sentences.en: He's busy, but he often comes to see me.
sentences.pron: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì jīngcháng lái kàn wǒ.

sentences.t: 虽然汉语很难，但是很有意思。
sentences.en: Chinese is hard, but it's interesting.
sentences.pron: Suīrán Hànyǔ hěn nán, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.

sentences.t: 虽然房间小，但是很干净。
sentences.en: The room is small, but it's clean.
sentences.pron: Suīrán fángjiān xiǎo, dànshì hěn gānjìng.

label: 把
note: Puts the object before the verb: what you do to it.
A 把 thing + verb + result: 把灯关上。

sentences.en: Please give me the phone.
sentences.pron: Qǐng bǎ shǒujī gěi wǒ.

sentences.en: He drank up the water.
sentences.pron: Tā bǎ shuǐ hē wán le.

sentences.en: I finished my homework.
sentences.pron: Wǒ bǎ zuòyè xiě wán le.

sentences.en: Please wash the clothes clean.
sentences.pron: Qǐng bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng.

sentences.en: Mom put the food in the fridge.
sentences.pron: Māma bǎ cài fàng jìn bīngxiāng le.

sentences.en: Did you take the medicine?
sentences.pron: Nǐ bǎ yào chī le ma?

sentences.en: Please shut the door properly.
sentences.pron: Qǐng bǎ mén guān hǎo.

label: 被
note: Passive: something is done to the subject.
thing 被 (doer) + verb + result

sentences.t: 我的自行车被朋友借走了。
sentences.en: My bike was borrowed by a friend.
sentences.pron: Wǒ de zìxíngchē bèi péngyou jiè zǒu le.

sentences.en: The cake was eaten up by my little brother.
sentences.pron: Dàngāo bèi dìdi chī wán le.

sentences.en: The fish was eaten by the cat.
sentences.pron: Yú bèi māo chī le.

sentences.en: He was called home by his mom.
sentences.pron: Tā bèi māma jiào huí jiā le.

sentences.en: Someone took my umbrella.
sentences.pron: Wǒ de sǎn bèi rén ná zǒu le.

sentences.en: The dog ate my bread.
sentences.pron: Wǒ de miànbāo bèi gǒu chī le.

label: 越来越
note: Something keeps getting more so.
越来越 + adjective: 天气越来越热。

sentences.en: It's getting hotter and hotter.
sentences.pron: Tiānqì yuèláiyuè rè le.

sentences.en: She's getting prettier and prettier.
sentences.pron: Tā yuèláiyuè piàoliang le.

sentences.en: My Chinese keeps getting better.
sentences.pron: Wǒ de Hànyǔ yuèláiyuè hǎo.

sentences.en: Things are getting more and more expensive.
sentences.pron: Dōngxi yuèláiyuè guì le.

sentences.en: The kids are getting taller and taller.
sentences.pron: Háizi yuèláiyuè gāo le.

sentences.en: He's getting busier and busier.
sentences.pron: Tā yuèláiyuè máng le.

sentences.en: More and more people come here.
sentences.pron: Lái zhèr de rén yuèláiyuè duō.

label: 一边…一边
note: Two actions at the same time.
一边 A 一边 B: 一边走一边唱。

sentences.en: He sings as he walks.
sentences.pron: Tā yībiān zǒu yībiān chànggē.

sentences.t: 我们一边喝茶一边看书。
sentences.en: We drink tea while we read.
sentences.pron: Wǒmen yībiān hē chá yībiān kàn shū.

sentences.t: 妈妈一边做菜一边听音乐。
sentences.en: Mom listens to music while she cooks.
sentences.pron: Māma yībiān zuò cài yībiān tīng yīnyuè.

sentences.en: Don't talk while you eat.
sentences.pron: Bié yībiān chī yībiān shuōhuà.

sentences.t: 他一边看手机一边走路。
sentences.en: He looks at his phone while he walks.
sentences.pron: Tā yībiān kàn shǒujī yībiān zǒulù.

sentences.en: I work and study at the same time.
sentences.pron: Wǒ yībiān gōngzuò yībiān xuéxí.

sentences.t: 爸爸一边看报纸一边喝咖啡。
sentences.en: Dad drinks coffee while he reads the paper.
sentences.pron: Bàba yībiān kàn bàozhǐ yībiān hē kāfēi.

label: 如果…就
note: States a condition and what follows from it.
如果 A，(subject) 就 B

sentences.en: If it rains, I won't go.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ xiàyǔ, wǒ jiù bù qù le.

sentences.en: If you're tired, have a rest.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ nǐ lèi le, jiù xiūxi ba.

sentences.en: If you have a question, ask me.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ yǒu wèntí, jiù wèn wǒ.

sentences.en: If you like it, buy it.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ nǐ xǐhuan, jiù mǎi ba.

sentences.t: 如果明天天气好，我们就去爬山。
sentences.en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go hiking.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.

sentences.en: If you're hungry, go ahead and eat.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ nǐ è le, jiù xiān chī ba.

sentences.t: 如果他不来，我就给他打电话。
sentences.en: If he doesn't come, I'll call him.
sentences.pron: Rúguǒ tā bù lái, wǒ jiù gěi tā dǎdiànhuà.

label: 先…然后
note: Puts two actions in order.
先 A，然后 B

sentences.en: I'll shower first, then go to bed.
sentences.pron: Wǒ xiān xǐzǎo, ránhòu shuìjiào.

sentences.t: 先吃东西，然后去看电影。
sentences.en: Let's eat first, then see a movie.
sentences.pron: Xiān chī dōngxi, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng.

sentences.en: Rest first, then get back to work.
sentences.pron: Nǐ xiān xiūxi, ránhòu zài gōngzuò.

sentences.t: 我们先去超市，然后回家。
sentences.en: We'll go to the supermarket first, then home.
sentences.pron: Wǒmen xiān qù chāoshì, ránhòu huí jiā.

sentences.en: Review first, then do the homework.
sentences.pron: Xiān fùxí, ránhòu zuò zuòyè.

sentences.t: 我们先坐地铁，然后走路回家。
sentences.en: We'll take the subway first, then walk home.
sentences.pron: Wǒmen xiān zuò dìtiě, ránhòu zǒulù huí jiā.

label: 又…又
note: Two qualities at once.
又 A 又 B: 又便宜又好吃。

sentences.en: This apple is big and sweet.
sentences.pron: Zhège píngguǒ yòu dà yòu tián.

sentences.en: His room is small and old.
sentences.pron: Tā de fángjiān yòu xiǎo yòu jiù.

sentences.t: 那个饭馆又便宜又好吃。
sentences.en: That restaurant is cheap and good.
sentences.pron: Nàge fànguǎn yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.

sentences.en: She's smart and pretty.
sentences.pron: Tā yòu cōngming yòu piàoliang.

sentences.en: I'm hungry and tired today.
sentences.pron: Wǒ jīntiān yòu è yòu lèi.

sentences.en: This park is big and quiet.
sentences.pron: Zhège gōngyuán yòu dà yòu ānjìng.

sentences.en: He's tall and thin.
sentences.pron: Tā yòu gāo yòu shòu.

label: 一…就
note: One action follows right after another.
一 A 就 B

sentences.en: I went to bed as soon as I got home.
sentences.pron: Wǒ yī dào jiā jiù shuìjiào le.

sentences.en: He smiled as soon as he saw me.
sentences.pron: Tā yī kànjiàn wǒ jiù xiào le.

sentences.en: She drinks coffee as soon as she gets up.
sentences.pron: Tā yī qǐchuáng jiù hē kāfēi.

sentences.en: As soon as the baby cries, Mom comes.
sentences.pron: Háizi yī kū, māma jiù lái le.

sentences.en: I understood as soon as I heard it.
sentences.pron: Wǒ yī tīng jiù dǒng le.

sentences.en: As soon as he has money, he travels.
sentences.pron: Tā yī yǒu qián jiù qù lǚyóu.

label: 只要…就
note: One condition is enough for the result.
只要 A，就 B

sentences.en: As long as you work hard, you'll succeed.
sentences.pron: Zhǐyào nǔlì, jiù néng chénggōng.

sentences.en: As long as you come, I'm happy.
sentences.pron: Zhǐyào nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.

sentences.t: 只要有时间，我就去看你。
sentences.en: As long as I have time, I'll come and see you.
sentences.pron: Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù kàn nǐ.

sentences.t: 只要多练习，汉语就会好。
sentences.en: With enough practice, your Chinese will get good.
sentences.pron: Zhǐyào duō liànxí, Hànyǔ jiù huì hǎo.

sentences.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.
sentences.pron: Zhǐyào bù xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù qù.

sentences.en: As long as you like it, it's yours.
sentences.pron: Zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan, jiù sòng gěi nǐ.

label: 不管…都
note: The result holds in every case.
不管 + question word or choice，都 B

sentences.en: However busy he is, he still works out.
sentences.pron: Bùguǎn duō máng, tā dōu qù duànliàn.

sentences.t: 不管你去哪儿，我都跟你去。
sentences.en: Wherever you go, I'll go with you.
sentences.pron: Bùguǎn nǐ qù nǎr, wǒ dōu gēn nǐ qù.

sentences.en: However expensive it is, I'll buy it.
sentences.pron: Bùguǎn duō guì, wǒ dōu yào mǎi.

sentences.en: Whoever comes, I won't open the door.
sentences.pron: Bùguǎn shéi lái, wǒ dōu bù kāi mén.

sentences.t: 不管做什么，他都很认真。
sentences.en: Whatever he does, he takes it seriously.
sentences.pron: Bùguǎn zuò shénme, tā dōu hěn rènzhēn.

sentences.t: 不管什么时候，你都可以来。
sentences.en: You can come any time.
sentences.pron: Bùguǎn shénme shíhou, nǐ dōu kěyǐ lái.

label: 连…也/都
note: Stresses an extreme case: even this.
连 X 也/都 + verb

sentences.t: 我连他的名字都不知道。
sentences.en: I don't even know his name.
sentences.pron: Wǒ lián tā de míngzi dōu bù zhīdào.

sentences.en: He didn't even drink any water.
sentences.pron: Tā lián shuǐ dōu méi hē.

sentences.en: Even the teacher can't do this question.
sentences.pron: Zhège tí lián lǎoshī yě bù huì.

sentences.en: She can't read a single character.
sentences.pron: Tā lián yī gè zì yě bù rènshi.

sentences.en: Even children know this.
sentences.pron: Lián háizi dōu zhīdào zhège.

sentences.en: He doesn't even have one yuan.
sentences.pron: Tā lián yī kuài qián dōu méi yǒu.

label: 既然…就
note: Takes a known fact as the reason.
既然 A，就 B

sentences.t: 既然你生病了，就在家休息吧。
sentences.en: Since you're sick, rest at home.
sentences.pron: Jìrán nǐ shēngbìng le, jiù zài jiā xiūxi ba.

sentences.en: Since you're here, come in and sit down.
sentences.pron: Jìrán lái le, jiù jìnlai zuòzuo.

sentences.t: 既然你不喜欢，就别买了。
sentences.en: Since you don't like it, don't buy it.
sentences.pron: Jìrán nǐ bù xǐhuan, jiù bié mǎi le.

sentences.t: 既然下雨了，我们就不去了。
sentences.en: Since it's raining, we won't go.
sentences.pron: Jìrán xiàyǔ le, wǒmen jiù bù qù le.

sentences.t: 既然他不来，我们就先吃吧。
sentences.en: Since he isn't coming, let's eat.
sentences.pron: Jìrán tā bù lái, wǒmen jiù xiān chī ba.

sentences.t: 既然知道错了，就要道歉。
sentences.en: Since you know you were wrong, apologize.
sentences.pron: Jìrán zhīdào cuò le, jiù yào dàoqiàn.

label: 即使…也
note: Even in that case, the result stays the same.
即使 A，也 B

sentences.en: Even if it rains, I'm going.
sentences.pron: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.

sentences.en: Even when he's tired, he doesn't rest.
sentences.pron: Jíshǐ hěn lèi, tā yě bù xiūxi.

sentences.t: 即使没有钱，我也很快乐。
sentences.en: Even without money, I'm happy.
sentences.pron: Jíshǐ méi yǒu qián, wǒ yě hěn kuàilè.

sentences.t: 即使他错了，你也别生气。
sentences.en: Even if he's wrong, don't get angry.
sentences.pron: Jíshǐ tā cuò le, nǐ yě bié shēngqì.

sentences.en: Even if it's hard, I won't give up.
sentences.pron: Jíshǐ hěn nán, wǒ yě bù fàngqì.

sentences.t: 即使明天下雪，我们也要出发。
sentences.en: Even if it snows tomorrow, we'll set off.
sentences.pron: Jíshǐ míngtiān xiàxuě, wǒmen yě yào chūfā.

label: 看起来
note: Gives an impression: looks, sounds, seems.
看起来 / 听起来 + adjective

sentences.en: You look tired.
sentences.pron: Nǐ kàn qǐlai hěn lèi.

sentences.en: This dish looks delicious.
sentences.pron: Zhège cài kàn qǐlai hěn hǎochī.

sentences.en: That sounds interesting.
sentences.pron: Tīng qǐlai hěn yǒu yìsi.

sentences.en: He looks young.
sentences.pron: Tā kàn qǐlai hěn niánqīng.

sentences.t: 这件衣服穿起来很舒服。
sentences.en: These clothes are comfortable to wear.
sentences.pron: Zhè jiàn yīfu chuān qǐlai hěn shūfu.

sentences.t: 这个问题看起来很简单。
sentences.en: This question looks easy.
sentences.pron: Zhège wèntí kàn qǐlai hěn jiǎndān.

sentences.en: She looks lovely when she smiles.
sentences.pron: Tā xiào qǐlai hěn piàoliang.

label: 越…越
note: One thing grows as another grows.
越 A 越 B: 越看越喜欢。

sentences.en: The snow is getting heavier.
sentences.pron: Xuě yuè xià yuè dà.

sentences.en: The more I look, the more I like it.
sentences.pron: Wǒ yuè kàn yuè xǐhuan.

sentences.en: He walks faster and faster.
sentences.pron: Tā yuè zǒu yuè kuài.

sentences.en: This book gets better the more I read.
sentences.pron: Zhè běn shū yuè dú yuè yǒu yìsi.

sentences.en: The more she thought, the angrier she got.
sentences.pron: Tā yuè xiǎng yuè shēngqì.

sentences.en: The more he eats, the fatter he gets.
sentences.pron: Tā yuè chī yuè pàng.

label: 才 vs 就
note: 就: sooner or easier than expected. 才: later or harder.
六点就起床了 · 十点才起床

sentences.en: He didn't get up until ten.
sentences.pron: Tā shí diǎn cái qǐchuáng.

sentences.en: I was up at six already.
sentences.pron: Wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.

sentences.en: She didn't get home until twelve.
sentences.pron: Tā shí'èr diǎn cái huí jiā.

sentences.en: He was done in just five minutes.
sentences.pron: Tā wǔ fēnzhōng jiù zuò wán le.

sentences.t: 我等了一个小时他才来。
sentences.en: I waited an hour before he finally came.
sentences.pron: Wǒ děng le yī gè xiǎoshí tā cái lái.

sentences.en: Why are you only coming now?
sentences.pron: Nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái lái?

sentences.en: We got there in no time.
sentences.pron: Wǒmen hěn kuài jiù dào le.

label: 难道
note: A rhetorical question: shows surprise or doubt.
难道 … 吗？

sentences.en: Don't tell me you don't know!
sentences.pron: Nándào nǐ bù zhīdào ma?

sentences.en: Could he be your older brother?
sentences.pron: Nándào tā shì nǐ gēge ma?

sentences.en: Did you really forget?
sentences.pron: Nándào nǐ wàngjì le ma?

sentences.en: Can this really be true?
sentences.pron: Nándào zhè shì zhēn de ma?

sentences.en: Don't you want to go?
sentences.pron: Nándào nǐ bù xiǎng qù ma?

sentences.en: Was I really wrong?
sentences.pron: Nándào wǒ cuò le ma?

label: 听得懂 / 听不懂
note: Says whether you can manage a result.
verb + 得/不 + result: 听得懂 · 听不懂

sentences.t: 老师说话很慢，我听得懂。
sentences.en: The teacher speaks slowly, so I can understand.
sentences.pron: Lǎoshī shuōhuà hěn màn, wǒ tīng de dǒng.

sentences.en: It's too fast, I can't follow.
sentences.pron: Tài kuài le, wǒ tīng bù dǒng.

sentences.t: 这个字很简单，我看得懂。
sentences.en: This character is easy; I can read it.
sentences.pron: Zhège zì hěn jiǎndān, wǒ kàn de dǒng.

sentences.en: It's too far, I can't see clearly.
sentences.pron: Tài yuǎn le, wǒ kàn bù qīngchu.

sentences.en: There's too much food, I can't finish it.
sentences.pron: Cài tài duō le, wǒ chī bù wán.

sentences.en: There isn't much homework; I can finish it.
sentences.pron: Zuòyè bù duō, wǒ zuò de wán.

sentences.en: I can't find my phone.
sentences.pron: Wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de shǒujī.

label: 不但…而且
note: Adds a second, stronger point.
不但 A，而且 B

sentences.t: 这里不但便宜，而且很方便。
sentences.en: It's not only cheap here but convenient too.
sentences.pron: Zhèlǐ bùdàn piányi, érqiě hěn fāngbiàn.

sentences.t: 她不但漂亮，而且很聪明。
sentences.en: She's not only pretty but smart too.
sentences.pron: Tā bùdàn piàoliang, érqiě hěn cōngming.

sentences.t: 他不但会唱歌，而且会跳舞。
sentences.en: He can not only sing but dance too.
sentences.pron: Tā bùdàn huì chànggē, érqiě huì tiàowǔ.

sentences.t: 这个菜不但香，而且不贵。
sentences.en: This dish not only smells good, it's cheap too.
sentences.pron: Zhège cài bùdàn xiāng, érqiě bù guì.

sentences.en: I'm not only tired but hungry too.
sentences.pron: Wǒ bùdàn hěn lèi, érqiě hěn è.

sentences.t: 她不但学习好，而且身体好。
sentences.en: She not only does well at school but is healthy too.
sentences.pron: Tā bùdàn xuéxí hǎo, érqiě shēntǐ hǎo.

label: 除了…以外
note: Besides X (also …), or except X (all …).
除了 X 以外，… 也/还/都 …

sentences.t: 除了咖啡以外，我也喝茶。
sentences.en: Besides coffee, I drink tea too.
sentences.pron: Chúle kāfēi yǐwài, wǒ yě hē chá.

sentences.t: 除了他以外，大家都来了。
sentences.en: Everyone came except him.
sentences.pron: Chúle tā yǐwài, dàjiā dōu lái le.

sentences.t: 除了周末以外，我都要上班。
sentences.en: I work every day except weekends.
sentences.pron: Chúle zhōumò yǐwài, wǒ dōu yào shàngbān.

sentences.t: 除了汉语以外，你还会什么？
sentences.en: Besides Chinese, what else do you know?
sentences.pron: Chúle Hànyǔ yǐwài, nǐ hái huì shénme?

sentences.t: 除了米饭以外，我还想要面条。
sentences.en: Besides rice, I'd also like noodles.
sentences.pron: Chúle mǐfàn yǐwài, wǒ hái xiǎng yào miàntiáo.

sentences.en: Nobody knows except me.
sentences.pron: Chúle wǒ yǐwài, méi rén zhīdào.
